snippet.text: theorem powerEvaluationMatrix_det_ne_zero (a x : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : Function.Injective a) (hx : StrictMono x) (hpos : ∀ j, 0 < x j) : (powerEvaluationMatrix a x).det ≠ 0, where powerEvaluationMatrix a x i j = x j ^ a i — the nonvanishing of the integrand's factor det[x_j^{α_i}] at ordered positive nodes, which the Lean proof feeds into the det B ≠ 0 conclusion by another route
